<h1>前言</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  地图引擎加载瓦片地图是基本操作，本篇对qgis添加图片瓦片地图。</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>

<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_13"></a>专业名词</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_14"></a>波段</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  波段（Band） 是指栅格数据中具有特定波长范围的信息层，类似于数字图像中的 “通道”。它是栅格数据（尤其是遥感影像）的核心组成部分，不同波段对应地物在不同电磁波谱范围内的反射或辐射特性。<br>  不同波段的电磁波与地物相互作用的方式不同，因此能反映地物的不同特征：</p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>单波段灰度：选择单个波段，以黑白灰度显示（如单独查看近红外波段）；</li>
<li>多波段色彩：将3个不同波段分别映射到红（R）、绿（G）、蓝（B）通道，形成彩色图像（如真彩色、假彩色合成）；</li>
<li>伪彩色：对单波段数据使用色带渐变显示（如 DEM 的高程渲染）</li>

</ul>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_20"></a>图层</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  图层是管理和展示地理数据的核心单元，所有空间数据（如矢量数据、栅格数据、瓦片地图等）都以图层形式加载和处理。QGIS 支持多种类型的图层：</p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>矢量图层（Vector Layers）</li>
<li>栅格图层（Raster Layers）</li>
<li>瓦片图层（Tile Layers）</li>
<li>标注图层（Label Layers）</li>
<li>网格图层（Grid Layers）</li>
<li>三维图层（3D Layers）</li>
<li>其他图层</li>

</ul>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_29"></a>栅格数据</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  一种以规则网格（像素或像元）形式存储的地理空间数据，每个网格单元（像素）包含一个或多个数值，用于表示连续的地理现象（如地形、温度、植被覆盖等）。QGIS 支持多种栅格格式，常见的包括：</p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>TIFF/GeoTIFF（.tif/.tiff）：最常用的带地理信息的栅格格式，支持多波段、压缩和空间参考。</li>
<li>JPEG/JPEG2000（.jpg/.jp2）：常用于卫星影像或航空照片，压缩率高。</li>
<li>PNG（.png）：支持透明通道，适合作为底图或符号。</li>
<li>GRID（ArcGIS Grid）：ESRI 的栅格格式，由多个文件组成。</li>
<li>NetCDF（.nc）：用于存储气象、海洋等多维栅格数据。</li>
<li>HDF（.hdf）：常用于遥感数据（如 MODIS、Landsat）。</li>

</ul>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="QgsRasterLayer_40"></a>QgsRasterLayer</h1>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_41"></a>概述</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  QgsRasterLayer是处理栅格数据的核心类，负责加载、显示渲染和操作栅格图层（如卫星影像、DEM 数据、遥感图像等）。<br>  QgsRasterLayer对象通常由QgsProject管理生命周期，添加到项目后不需要手动删除。<br>  QGIS的大部分API不是线程安全的，应避免在非主线程中操作栅格图层。<br>  QgsRasterLayer支持多种栅格格式，具体取决于编译 QGIS 时启用的 GDAL 驱动。</p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_46"></a>核心功能与特性</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>栅格数据加载：支持多种栅格格式（GeoTIFF、JPEG、PNG、DEM 等），底层通过GDAL库实现格式解析。</li>
<li>属性信息获取：可获取图层范围、分辨率、波段数、坐标参考系（CRS）等元数据。</li>
<li>像素数据访问：提供接口读取指定坐标或区域的像素值，支持单像素查询和区域数据提取。</li>
<li>渲染控制： 支持多种渲染方式（单波段灰度、多波段 RGB、伪彩色等），可自定义颜色映射。</li>
<li>项目集成：可添加到QgsProject中进行管理，与地图画布（QgsMapCanvas）联动显示。</li>

</ul>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_52"></a>常用属性和操作</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_53"></a>创建栅格图层</h3>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 栅格文件路径和图层名称

<span class="token comment">// 创建栅格图层

<span class="token comment">// 检查图层是否有效

<span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token function">qDebug<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"栅格图层加载失败: " <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; rasterLayer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">error<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">message<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token keyword">delete rasterLayer<span class="token punctuation">;
  <span class="token keyword">return <span class="token number">1<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<h3><a id="_111"></a>设置栅格图层渲染方式</h3>

<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token macro property"><span class="token directive-hash">#<span class="token directive keyword">include <span class="token string">&lt;qgsrasterrenderer.h&gt;

<span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token comment">// 获取当前渲染器
    QgsRasterRenderer<span class="token operator">* renderer <span class="token operator">= rasterLayer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">renderer<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="QGis_134"></a>QGis加载瓦片地图的配置</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="XYZXML_135"></a>加载在线XYZ瓦片的XML配置</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  在线XYZ瓦片的XML配置文件通常用于批量导入多个瓦片服务连接。示例如下：</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-xml"><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;qgsXYZTilesConnections <span class="token attr-name">version<span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=<span class="token punctuation">"1.0<span class="token punctuation">"<span class="token punctuation">&gt;
    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;xyztiles

        <span class="token attr-name">name<span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=<span class="token punctuation">"ESRI 卫星<span class="token punctuation">"

        <span class="token attr-name">referer<span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=<span class="token punctuation">"https://www.arcgis.com/<span class="token punctuation">"

<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/qgsXYZTilesConnections<span class="token punctuation">&gt;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_212"></a>关于拽托渲染延迟刷新</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_213"></a>概述</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  拖拽地图时不实时刷新、松开后延迟刷新的现象，与地图渲染策略和事件处理机制有关。</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>渲染性能优化机制：QGIS为避免拖拽过程中频繁渲染导致的卡顿，**默认采用“拖拽时暂停渲染，松开后再刷新”的策略。**这是对低性能设备的保护机制，尤其当栅格图层分辨率高、数据量大时，实时渲染会消耗大量CPU/GPU资源。</li>
<li>事件处理优先级：拖拽操作（如鼠标拖动QgsMapCanvas）属于高频事件（如mouseMoveEvent）。若在事件触发时立即调用刷新接口（如refresh()或repaint()），会导致事件队列阻塞，反而降低体验。</li>
<li>栅格图层的特殊性：栅格数据渲染需要处理大量像素（尤其是大尺寸/高分辨率图层），拖拽时实时重绘可能导致明显延迟，因此框架默认选择延迟刷新。</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_218"></a>实时刷新方案一：调整画布刷新策略</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 获取地图画布指针（假设已初始化）
QgsMapCanvas<span class="token operator">* canvas <span class="token operator">= <span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 禁用"拖拽时暂停渲染"的优化
canvas<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">setParallelRenderingEnabled<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token boolean">true<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token comment">// 启用并行渲染（多核加速）
canvas<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">setRenderFlag<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token boolean">true<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token comment">// 强制始终允许渲染

<span class="token comment">// 调整刷新触发方式：在鼠标移动时主动触发刷新
<span class="token function">connect<span class="token punctuation">(canvas<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token operator">&amp;QgsMapCanvas<span class="token operator">::extentsChanged<span class="token punctuation">, canvas<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token operator">&amp;QgsMapCanvas<span class="token operator">::refresh<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_230"></a>实时刷新方案二：优化栅格图层渲染性能</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  若实时刷新仍卡顿，可降低渲染负载：</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 临时降低栅格图层分辨率（拖拽时）
QgsRasterLayer<span class="token operator">* rasterLayer <span class="token operator">= <span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token punctuation">;
rasterLayer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">setDrawingStyle<span class="token punctuation">(QgsRasterLayer<span class="token operator">::DrawingStyle<span class="token operator">::Preview<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token comment">// 预览模式（低分辨率）

<span class="token comment">// 拖拽结束后恢复高质量渲染
<span class="token comment">// 在鼠标释放事件中：
rasterLayer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">setDrawingStyle<span class="token punctuation">(QgsRasterLayer<span class="token operator">::DrawingStyle<span class="token operator">::Default<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
canvas<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">refresh<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="QgsMapCanvas_242"></a>实时刷新方案三：自定义事件处理通过重写QgsMapCanvas的鼠标事件，控制刷新时机</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token keyword">class <span class="token class-name">CustomMapCanvas <span class="token operator">: <span class="token base-clause"><span class="token keyword">public <span class="token class-name">QgsMapCanvas
<span class="token punctuation">{
    Q_OBJECT
<span class="token keyword">public<span class="token operator">:
    <span class="token keyword">using QgsMapCanvas<span class="token operator">::QgsMapCanvas<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token keyword">protected<span class="token operator">:
    <span class="token keyword">void <span class="token function">mouseMoveEvent<span class="token punctuation">(QMouseEvent<span class="token operator">* e<span class="token punctuation">) override
    <span class="token punctuation">{
        <span class="token comment">// 调用父类方法处理拖拽逻辑
        <span class="token class-name">QgsMapCanvas<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">mouseMoveEvent<span class="token punctuation">(e<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
        
        <span class="token comment">// 拖拽过程中主动刷新（仅在鼠标按下时）
        <span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(e<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">buttons<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">&amp; Qt<span class="token operator">::LeftButton<span class="token punctuation">)
        <span class="token punctuation">{
            <span class="token keyword">this<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">refresh<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token comment">// 实时刷新
        <span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="QGgsProject_267"></a>关于图层QGgsProject</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  经过简单测试，确认画布添加图层，这个QGgsProject里面不添加图层：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/a09557755b114b02beac68bcf9c15c89.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/5b4eaf55f41d451aab23ad6720a7ab4c.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  这个全局类应该是为了方便一些缓存调用，省的自己管理类，还有一些函数，比如图层是否显示是否包含等等基本操作，还有一个最重要的是项目结束的时候，添加进去的元素项目类实例都会自动销毁，无需手动销毁。</p>

</div>

<h1><a id="v110_316"></a>工程模板v1.1.0</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/290c562d6e3f4d8bb8f868dacb0c221a.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_322"></a>入坑</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_323"></a>入坑一：纵横比显示错误</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_324"></a>问题</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  纵横比显示错误，导致变形<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/6dc8de43eddc4435a957bcaf1f272c62.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/d0a456bd57fa43abb5cfb695262b2ccf.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_330"></a>原因</h3>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  Xml的坐标系范围不对</p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_332"></a>解决</h3>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  修正xml配置参数<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/3ff418926a2f410a9207181ef48bd88b.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_336"></a>入坑二：修改坐标系种类后空白</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_337"></a>问题</h3>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  修改坐标系后空表<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/4969d3993b704ba5bff3959e276d858e.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/f78e960e65e1442488f56ed0b6da16b2.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/e665395a81f048ec99c501daa6d8d717.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_345"></a>尝试</h3>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  确保投影定义使用正确的EPSG代码格式，确认没问题。<br>  打开桌面版QGIS看他支持不：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/022a4069d641479388a3d771ce893abf.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/aa74a8cbdf804274b199d7225528e1ee.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  是支持的。</p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_353"></a>解决</h3>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  是数据库.db的问题，部署环境的时候，需要带上：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/377191edfe624980b3b6e3a02ec32c71.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  开发环境的把proj.db带上去，再测试可以了：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/5cb57110cccc466f88cc7b18d8d7c10c.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/9b8921fa7c3349ffa4f3b1ebc4373f84.png" class="lazyload"></p>
